name: Red Wings Widget
description: Detroit Red Wings NHL schedule widget + companion app: next-game countdown, last result, and division standings.
changelog: Adopted Concept 2: Frosted Ice & Home Red Sweater as the default look for the Home Red jersey theme.
Added Home Red sweater ribbon header with dual white racing stripes, embossed Winged Wheel logo, and white Detroit Red Wings wordmark.
Upgraded widget substrate to frosted ice acrylic glassmorphism with crisp white specular border.
Added red illuminated highlight pill for Detroit Red Wings in the Atlantic division standings.
Added floating frosted glass venue pill for Little Caesars Arena / game location.
Eliminated GitHub Actions release asset race conditions on concurrent pushes.
